entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I heard you went home, so I[n]announced it during homeroom...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Planning something with[n]Sakamoto-kun and the others, huh?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Well, try not to trouble the[n]school or the parents, OK?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Also... make sure you're[n]keeping up with your studies!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'll handle your housework as[n]long as you request me!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I heard you went home, so I[n]announced it during homeroom...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: The news is reporting[n]you committed suicide...[n]Call me when you can.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But... as long as you're safe...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Don't worry about school! Just[n]take care of yourself.
